_comment: The initial route's weight budget, in gzip bytes, read by BOTH
(which additionally proves the AI layer is not in the initial route).
One file, so the gate and the test cannot disagree about the number.
'initialJs' is the session brief's own figure: 250 KB gzip for every
script index.html pulls in — the entry chunk, the runtime and every
modulepreload. It replaces the pre-AI BASELINE + 30 KB rule that ADR-011
set, which three sessions of i18n growth had put out of reach with no
route to bring it back (docs/DATA-GAPS.md #55). See ADR-030.
'initialCss' and 'largestChunk' are not in the brief. They are here
because a JS-only budget is trivially satisfied by moving weight into a
stylesheet or by shipping one enormous lazy chunk, and neither would be
an improvement for the reader on a slow connection.
Chunks allowed past largestChunk, each with the reason. A dataset is
one JSON string behind a ?raw dynamic import (ADR-013/ADR-018): it is
never parsed as JavaScript, never on the initial route, and is fetched
only when a reader opens the module that needs it.
chunkExemptions.bns: data/law/bns.json — the whole Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, ?raw
chunkExemptions.bnss: data/law/bnss.json — the whole Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, ?raw
chunkExemptions.bsa: data/law/bsa.json — the whole Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, ?raw
chunkExemptions.docx: the docx writer, imported inside the export handler only (ADR-020)
chunkExemptions.web-llm: @mlc-ai/web-llm — Tier 0's on-device runtime, 2.1 MB gzip and by far the largest chunk in this build. It is exempt for the same reason `docx` is and then some: it is reached only through the dynamic imports inside src/ai/local/engine.ts, which run when the reader presses Download in Settings — not when Settings opens and not when Tier 0 is selected. It is also the one chunk excluded from the service worker's precache (globIgnores in vite.config.ts), so a device that never turns AI on never holds a byte of it. Its name is fixed by manualChunks precisely so this line, that globIgnore and the confinement assertion in tests/no-external-urls.test.ts can all refer to it. ADR-037.
chunkExemptions.MockPage: recharts, behind the Trainer's mock-test route
